rationale: HELE has gapped up ~15% on no news, is trading at 98.2% of its intraday range near the session high with extremely compressed 1-minute candles (tiny bodies, low volume except the last bar), suggesting exhaustion rather than continuation. The risk/reward for a long at the top of a large gap-up move is poor, and shorting into a stock with this much momentum and no clear catalyst explanation carries equal risk of a squeeze. With no directional edge identifiable and the price pinned near the high, the prudent action is to stand aside.
